# Bundled editor components

These files ship in the application and require no startup downloads.

- `../colors/molokai.vim`: https://github.com/tomasr/molokai at
  `c67bdfcdb31415aa0ade7f8c003261700a885476`, copied unchanged from the local
  installation. License: `molokai/LICENSE.md`.
- `vim-surround`: https://github.com/tpope/vim-surround at
  `3d188ed2113431cf8dac77be61b842acb64433d9`. Plugin, help and README copied
  unchanged. Copyright Tim Pope; Vim license (see its README and Neovim
  `:help license`). Loaded only by the managed configuration.

The native statusline uses Airline dark's normal neon green (`#dfff00`),
insert cyan (`#00dfff`) and visual orange (`#ffaf00`) accents.
